layer01-sub-bass.name: layer01-sub-bass
layer01-sub-bass.description: Clean triangle Sub Direct. Mandatory host LP 80 Hz; quarter-note pump. C0 F0 Ab0 Bb0 (Cubase).

layer02-octave-bass.name: layer02-octave-bass
layer02-octave-bass.description: Tight saw octave sequencer; short filter decay; high-pass after saturation separates the sub.

layer03-chord-stabs.name: layer03-chord-stabs
layer03-chord-stabs.description: Juno/Jupiter-like saw stabs, modest detune and vintage chorus; low-mid space for bass.

layer04-synth-brass.name: layer04-synth-brass
layer04-synth-brass.description: Slow-35-ms brightness swell then broad saw/square brass sustain; large hall accents.

layer05-bright-arp.name: layer05-bright-arp
layer05-bright-arp.description: External-MIDI 16th pluck arp; chorus and asymmetric 1/8 + 1/16 stereo echoes.

layer06-glass-bells.name: layer06-glass-bells
layer06-glass-bells.description: Sine carrier A FM from enabled silent sine B +7 semitones; high glass bell and Space reverb, no pitch-shift shimmer.

layer07-warm-pad.name: layer07-warm-pad
layer07-warm-pad.description: Soft analog pad, common-tone ties across Cm/Fm/Ab/Bb; gentle independent brightness/PWM movement.

layer08-main-lead.name: layer08-main-lead
layer08-main-lead.description: Original four-bar C-minor hook, 50-ms mono legato glide; short overlapping MIDI notes. Wheel adds vibrato.

layer09-synth-whistle.name: layer09-synth-whistle
layer09-synth-whistle.description: Sine plus soft square disco whistle; delayed vibrato. Answers only at the end of bars 2 and 4.

layer10-transition-fx.name: layer10-transition-fx
layer10-transition-fx.description: Velocity-1 four-bar noise rise; velocity-127 sine impact with falling pitch/level. Two simultaneous voices, no hard key split.
